title: Keeping a Python API responsive during slow I/O
summary: Synchronous HTTP calls inside an async endpoint block the event loop. Offload blocking functions to a bounded thread pool or use an asynchronous HTTP client so other requests can continue.

title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion for hybrid retrieval
summary: RRF combines keyword and semantic result lists using reciprocal ranks. Documents supported by both retrievers accumulate contributions without requiring comparable raw similarity scores.

title: A PostgreSQL vector-search example repository
summary: Store embeddings alongside relational data and retrieve documents by cosine distance with pgvector. Keep ownership and metadata filters in the database query.

title: Measuring retrieval with Recall@k and MRR
summary: Use labeled queries and relevant documents to evaluate search. Recall measures how much relevant material appears in the top results; reciprocal rank measures where the first relevant result appears.

title: Schema-validated LLM metadata
summary: Use a structured response schema to generate titles, summaries and reusable tags. Validate model output and normalize tags before using them in the application.

title: Query and document embedding task types
summary: Embed saved documents using the retrieval-document task and search text using the retrieval-query task. Keep embedding model and dimensions consistent across stored and query vectors.

title: Graceful degradation when an AI provider is unavailable
summary: Use explicit deadlines and bounded retries for external AI services. When query embeddings are unavailable, return keyword-search results and log the degraded operation without exposing private query text.

title: Video walkthrough: evaluating a retrieval assistant
summary: A synthetic video description about testing a RAG assistant with answerable and unanswerable queries, inspecting source references, and reviewing retrieval failures.
